name: Bugle Crowns
summary: My AI agent team in the AWS Agentic Football Cup — five agents, 120-second matches.
description: Bugle Crowns is my team in the AWS Agentic Football Cup, where AI agents play 120-second football matches against each other. Each of the five positions runs its own agent with its own instructions, and every week's results feed back into the next round of tactical tuning.
